commits.subject: Stabilize app-server `app/list` integration tests (#62162)
commits.reason: Use a watch gate to make mock directory response ordering deterministic and a bundled model catalog to keep connector tests from performing unrelated discovery.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 b574d333da64d28f0bfee9924db28d2d475fe79e681ed0efef50a2796352b30f.

The fixture holds directory responses until the accessible-only tools update is observed. During forced refresh, it then requires the very next update to include the fresh directory. The config rewrite retains the explicit local model catalog.
commits.revisit: Run the app/list notification-order and thread feature-flag fixtures with the maintained suite timeout.

commits.subject: Move the app-server socket relay into the Codex CLI (#62163)
commits.reason: Move the relay into its only supported command and drop the unused standalone crate and hidden subcommand. Keep app-server proxy endpoint selection and the byte forwarding behavior.
evidence: Reviewed the exact parent-to-commit patch, SHA256 941d5c4e53941a6c550a7b3d29b8d9bf6432cba42931881daa5efab363224412.

The original relay body moves into the CLI. The caller still resolves an explicit socket path or the app-server control socket under the current CODEX_HOME. No ALab-owned packaging or runtime caller references the removed command or crate at main 03e3970327.
commits.revisit: Run the new app_server_proxy integration test and check the default control socket path in the native CLI.
